biases_detected.description: Calculates signal using close_t price and assumes execution at same close_t price on the same day.
Used S&P 500 index constituents from October 2025 retrospectively back to 2018. Missed 34 delisted tickers.
Flat 1bp fee does not account for bid-ask spread crossing and non-linear market impact for trades exceeding 10% ADV.

remediation_requirements.description: Add 1-day lag to signal execution (compute signal at Close_t, execute at VWAP_t+1).
Ingest point-in-time constituent list from CRSP database.
Integrate non-linear Almgren-Chriss square-root market impact formula.
